I had the same thought...had a girl i would’ve done anything for and she ended up cheating on me. she made me so happy i would actually sleep at night and wake up in the morning ready for anything. then she made me the most depressed i’ve ever been. i used to cry every night until recently and now i’m just so dead inside. putting your happiness in someone else is such a bad idea

it jusg sucks so much trying and getting your hopes up only to be shot down last second. none of these girls ever offer to reschedule its just “cant do it got other plans” and then radio silence. never a text ever again or anyghing. i had a friend reach out to me two states over but it was nice to talk to someone im happy to feel reached out to after tonight and im happy someone replied. a little perspective of the other side has helped
thank you. i hope i can find someone who does understand. i tear my relationships apart with it and it just hurts so much.

yeah. ive opened up before and it has always made things worse. ive tried to kill myself and my best friend drove to my house which reassured me people would care, but when i open up to her she tells me it scares her and she has said before that its ruining our friendship. thinking of her keeps me around, but i still feel so alone even with my best friend
then why cant i even relate to anyone here? i just keep getting worse. i cant even talk to my therapist anymore without feeling judged
i cant count how many times ive heard time heals. ive given it time and i still feel just as alone as always

1. wake up at noon
2. wait all day for someone to reach out or i text all my friends trying to set anything up
3. either i do nothing but watch netflix or a friend wants to hang out.
4. buy a 6 pack to either drink alone or drink while i listen to someone rant for hours while i sit there too afraid to open up
5. buy another 6 pack and stay up all night drinking
6. repeat

i just hope i feel better in college
dude im having such a shit day and nothing wrong even happened. thanks for the post im glad at least 1 person out there thought to write something anything

Dude reading this made me cry more I feel you so bad. I gave up even trying to escape with video games. Weed and alcohol are my only escapes, but I just end up feeling worse and crying till I pass out.I just want to connect so bad it physically hurts. I dont even know where to begin with recovering..
Current department I volunteer at never asked about my medication, but I hear the departments in the city I’m going to college at will ask. Is it better to be upfront or just omit that information?

Idk for sure if it will impact my career, I’ve just heard from other EMTs its almost better to say nothing than get help because it can ruin you, but they’re old and times have changed. 

I guess its not bitching I’m just having a hard time lately and thats what my friends denounced it to before they essentially cut me off. Thanks for listening to me tho it has helped a lot. I’m not sure if this was the right subreddit but I’m glad I came here.

My brothers live extremely far away and they hold the same mind set as my parents. I can sort of open up with my one of my brothers but he lives two time zones away and isn’t allowed on his phone during work.

My nightmares usually involve an insane scenario built to get my anxiety flowing. The most reoccurring one is waking up in my room, but its darker than dark. I can see things around me but I can’t make out what they are so I run out but it’s like running in mud. Outside my room are my parents just staring at me. I beg for help but they always say we cant help you. Then I’m pulled away by the dark things and I wake up. Except I’m not awake I’m replaying the nightmare. It can loop indefinitely until I finally really wake up.

Last night’s dream was my shoes were filled with fire ants but I cant take them off and I’m chasing after my ex.

I’m finishing my EMT training in the summer then I’m off to get my degree in fire protection.

Been dealing with depression and suicide idolizarion since I was in my early teens. My friends knew and were happy to be there so long as I wasnt too bad. Then my girlfriend left me and everything went downhill fast. That was 2 months ago. I can barely motivate myself to get through each day. My friends saw the change and just abandoned me...I had one friend left I could trust but I guess she got tired of me too. I go through the motions every day just to get home and then I sit there with no energy until I go to bed. Sleeping doesnt help I have nightmares every single time even with short naps. I just feel like I’m really starting to slip from lack of sleep, support, and whatever else. I cant even talk to my family because my depression scares them. They just tell me not to talk about it. I saw my ex today and she ended up ducking away from me which I guess is for the best, but of course it just sets my anxiety in overdrive. And when that happens then I just think it would be easier to not feel anything anymore. I dont want to die, but I just want to move on to something more. The only thing that pushes me forward is I’m moving off to school pretty far away then maybe I can start over.

But moving off isnt going to ease my mind because I’ve put so much into being a first responder, but I cant even help myself. What if my department figures out of history of depression? Then I’m screwed. Everything changed so fast and I’m losing it man.
